<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':39}])
print('res', {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','reward','score')})
def cells(frame):
    s=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch not in 'Bg': s.add((i,j,ch))
    return s
b=cells(transitions[-1].before_frame); a=cells(current_frame)
print('added', sorted(a-b)[:25])
print('removed', sorted(b-a)[:25])
def pix(ascii_str, chars):
    out={}
    for i,line in enumerate(ascii_str.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch in chars: out.setdefault(ch,[]).append((i,j))
    return out
cur = pix(current_frame.ascii, 'WwM')
print('M', sorted(cur.get('M',[])))
print('W(ball)', [p for p in sorted(cur.get('W',[])) if p[1]>5])
print('w(track)', sorted(cur.get('w',[])))
</parameter>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':21,'col':39}])
print('res', {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','reward','score')})
def cells(frame):
    s=set()
    for i,line in enumerate(frame.ascii.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch not in 'Bg': s.add((i,j,ch))
    return s
b=cells(transitions[-1].before_frame); a=cells(current_frame)
print('added', sorted(a-b)[:25])
print('removed', sorted(b-a)[:25])
def pix(ascii_str, chars):
    out={}
    for i,line in enumerate(ascii_str.split('\n')):
        for j,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch in chars: out.setdefault(ch,[]).append((i,j))
    return out
cur = pix(current_frame.ascii, 'WwM')
print('M', sorted(cur.get('M',[])))
print('W(ball)', [p for p in sorted(cur.get('W',[])) if p[1]>5])
print('w(track)', sorted(cur.get('w',[])))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
